errors.evidence: Code snippet called python_interpreter with arguments to invoke search_agent, a tool that is not defined in the available tool set.
errors.description: The agent attempted to use the undefined python_interpreter tool to call the search_agent team member, violating the tool specification.

errors.evidence: Code snippet used python_interpreter to execute final_answer, instead of calling the final_answer tool directly.
errors.description: The agent used the wrong tool (python_interpreter) to produce the final answer, bypassing the designated final_answer tool.

errors.evidence: The web_search tool was called a second time with the exact same query that had already been executed earlier.
errors.description: Repeated a tool call with identical parameters, contrary to the rule that forbids re‑doing the same tool call.

errors.evidence: Web search results returned six links, none of which were the actual BBC Earth YouTube video page; the first result was a different video.
errors.description: The agent failed to retrieve the primary source (the YouTube video) needed to answer the question, relying on unrelated pages instead.

errors.evidence: The final_answer tool was invoked with an answer derived from a GitHub benchmark file that merely repeats the question and answer, not from the video transcript or description.
errors.description: The agent treated the GitHub reference as definitive evidence of the bird species in the video, misinterpreting the tool output and producing a potentially unsupported answer.

errors.evidence: The system delivered a final answer without performing the required verification steps (e.g., visiting the YouTube page or inspecting the transcript).
errors.description: The agent ignored the explicit instruction to run verification steps using the appropriate tools before answering.

scores.reliability_reasoning: The answer was produced without consulting the primary video source and relied on secondary references, making the result questionable.
scores.security_reasoning: No unsafe operations, external exploits, or data leaks were observed in the trace.
scores.instruction_adherence_reasoning: The agent failed to follow the mandated verification steps and used incorrect tools, breaching the task instructions.
scores.plan_opt_reasoning: The high‑level plan was reasonable, but execution deviated from the plan by using wrong tools and not performing the required verification.
